It didn't. In 2024 the Fed cut from 5.25-5.50% to 4.25-4.50%, with 50 bp in September, then 25 bp each in November and December, as inflation cooled and the labor market softened.

You may be thinking of the zero-rate episodes: December 2008 to 2015 (financial crisis) and March 2020 to March 2022 (COVID).
